description: This file implements the GatewayDiscovery class in Kotlin, which performs service discovery for gateways using network service discovery (NSD), DNS, and system DNS resolver. It manages local and wide-area discovery, resolving services, handling DNS TXT records, and updates StateFlow variables with the list of detected gateways and status.

classes.name: GatewayDiscovery
classes.description: Class responsible for discovering gateway services using network discovery protocols, DNS, and DNS-over-HTTP, maintaining lists of local and wide-area gateways, resolving service details, and exposing the discovered gateways and status text as StateFlow observables.

methods.name: startLocalDiscovery
methods.description: Initiates the local network service discovery using NSD.

methods.name: stopLocalDiscovery
methods.description: Stops the local network service discovery.

methods.name: startUnicastDiscovery
methods.description: Starts background task to perform unicast DNS discovery periodically.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a given network service info to retrieve detailed service data and adds it to local gateways.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Updates the observable list of gateways and status text.

methods.name: buildStatusText
methods.description: Constructs human-readable status text based on current discovery state.
